task_description: Add a third 'Reassign' decision option to the Access Review ISC UI plugin (visual-certs). A reviewer can hand a review item to another identity (searchable name/email picker) with a required comment (preset-or-custom), via CertificationsApi.reassignIdentityCertificationsV1. Reassigned items leave the queue and count as resolved. Decomposed into a data+domain foundation feature and a UI+wiring feature.
